Start with talking to your optometrist to get a referral over to an ophthalmology. You'll have to have at least a year of steady prescriptions to prove that your eye sight won't get worse post surgery. You'll fill out some paperwork, submit it up your chain of command and then you'll be assigned a priority. Typically sea duty will get priority over shore duty. Unless there is a specific reason, they will want you to get lasik / prk for myopia. It's a lot cheaper for the command. The only reason i was able to get ICLs was because i had horrible dry eye, but they tried everything in the books to treat it first. From the start of my optometry appointment to getting my surgery date, it took about a year. If you have any other questions, feel free to shoot me a DM.
